segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled the updated pricing sheet for 48 seats, annual term, and the implementation package we discussed. I wanted to confirm the rollout date before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We're targeting May 20 for go-live. We'd need admin training the week before, probably May 13 or 14, if your team has availability.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That should work. I checked with services this morning and May 14 at 1:00 Eastern is open. For the 48 seats, the subscription comes to $31,680 for the year, and implementation is a one-time $4,200.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that's in line with what I had. Can you split the invoice so the subscription bills now and the services bill after the kickoff?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that. I'll note in the billing tool: subscription invoice on signature, services invoice after the kickoff call. Payment terms are net 30 on both unless you need something different.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 is fine. Legal asked about auto-renewal. We can accept it if there's a 60-day notice window and no more than 5% uplift.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, our standard is 60 days and the renewal cap would be 5%. I'll make sure that language is in the order form and matches the contract terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If you send it today, I can route it for signature tomorrow. Purchasing usually takes two business days once I submit.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll send the order form by 3:00 today, copy you and Marcus in procurement, and include the implementation dates in the notes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Once it's signed, send me the kickoff agenda and the admin checklist.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. And just to confirm, the initial admins are you, Marcus, and Priya, with 45 standard users after that?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. That's the right count for launch.
